Welcome to Vice Chancellor's Secretariat

Prof. Dr. Jamil Ahmad
Vice Chancellor,

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
vc@awkum.edu.pk

It is my pleasure to welcome you to the official website of Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM). I take great pride in leading an institution that is committed to academic excellence, research, and the holistic development of our students.
At AWKUM, we strive to create an environment that fosters innovation, critical thinking, and a passion for learning. Our dedicated faculty members, state-of-the-art facilities, and a diverse range of academic programs ensure that our students receive a comprehensive and enriching educational experience.

Click here (https://awkum.edu.pk/about-us/vice-chancellor-message/)
